entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Botiya @ Boti Devi & Anr. .... .... .... Petitioner(s) Versus The State of Jharkhand & Anr. .... .... ....

Opposite Party (s)
------
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Pradeep Kumar Srivastava
------
For the Petitioners : Mr. Gautam Kumar, Advocate Mrs. Pushpanjali Kumar Singh, Adv.
 For the State : Mr. Fahad Allam, A.P.P.
 For the O.P. No.2 : None
 ------
 Order No.19 Dated- 13.06.2024

Initially Mr. Rakesh Kumar Gupta filed Vakalatnama on behalf of the opposite party No.2 but later on he left the parvi and Mrs. Rajni Singh, learned advocate was appointed as Amicus Curiae for the opposite party No.2.
This case pertains for the offences under section 498A of IPC and the participation of opposite party No.2 is necessary in this case.

In view thereof, let fresh notice be issued through the D.L.S.A., Sahibganj to serve the notice upon the said applicant with specific direction to secure her attendance before this Court by providing legal assistance.

(Pradeep Kumar Srivastava, J.) Pappu/
